content.value_statement: Large educational books can become inconsistent, overloaded, or hard to navigate. This skill creates structured plans with chapter flow, dependencies, and learning checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Defines multi-part book architecture with chapters, parts, and learning progression.
Maps chapter prerequisites, reading paths, and dependency relationships.
Plans chapter purpose, outcomes, concepts, exercises, and success criteria.
Applies cognitive load guidance for beginner, intermediate, and advanced readers.
Provides YAML templates and validation scripts for outline quality checks.
Supports review of completed content against pedagogical and accessibility standards.
limitations: Does not write complete manuscript chapters by itself.
Requires a clear audience, topic, and book goal from the user.
Validation scripts expect structured YAML outlines that follow the included templates.
Does not verify technical facts or external references in generated book plans.

use_cases.title: Plan a Technical Book
use_cases.description: Create a part and chapter structure before drafting a programming or software engineering book.

use_cases.title: Design a Learning Path
use_cases.description: Turn a complex subject into sequenced lessons with outcomes, practice, and prerequisites.

use_cases.title: Review a Book Outline
use_cases.description: Check an existing outline for dependency gaps, overloaded chapters, and unclear progression.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Book Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use book-scaffolding to plan a beginner-friendly book about [topic] for [audience]. Create parts, chapter titles, and a simple learning progression.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Part Spec
prompt_templates.prompt: Use book-scaffolding to define Part [number] of my book. Include its purpose, narrative arc, chapter outcomes, concept density, and hands-on exercises.

prompt_templates.title: Map Chapter Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Use book-scaffolding to review these chapter titles and map required, recommended, optional, and related dependencies. Identify cycles and missing prerequisites.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Full Learning Journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Use book-scaffolding to audit this full book outline for cognitive load, flow pattern fit, success criteria, accessibility, and gaps between parts.

output_examples.input: A beginner Python book needs a clear path from setup to small projects.
output: A four-part structure that starts with orientation and setup.
Chapter outcomes that move from reading code to building small programs.
Dependency notes that keep advanced topics after required foundations.

output_examples.input: An existing outline has many advanced chapters near the start.
output: A pacing review that flags heavy concept density in early chapters.
A revised order with optional advanced chapters moved later.
Recommendations for bridging exercises and prerequisite callouts.

output_examples.input: A content team needs standards for every chapter plan.
output: A repeatable chapter spec with purpose, outcomes, concepts, examples, exercises, and success criteria.
A checklist for show-then-explain teaching and accessible language.

best_practices: Provide the target audience, prior knowledge, and desired book outcome before asking for structure.
Plan one part in detail at a time while keeping the full book journey visible.
Review dependency maps before drafting chapters that build on earlier material.
anti_patterns: Do not create every part specification before the early chapters are validated.
Do not overload beginner chapters with many new concepts and low scaffolding.
Do not treat chapters as isolated pieces without prerequisites or forward links.

faq.question: What kind of books does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports educational and technical books that need planned progression across parts, chapters, examples, and exercises.

faq.question: Can it write the full manuscript?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on structure, planning, specifications, and review criteria for later drafting work.

faq.question: Does it include templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes book outline and chapter structure templates for consistent planning.

faq.question: Can it check chapter dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. The included guidance and scripts help identify prerequisite chains, cycles, and unreachable chapters.

faq.question: Is it useful for nontechnical books?
faq.answer: It can help any educational book, but its examples and scripts are designed for technical learning material.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
